notes.title: Playtest Update For Turn-based RPG Fest!
notes.content:
Hail Captain!

Come check out the latest playtest demo; it's open to all!

I've made some extensive changes to the graphical presentation and added a collidable element to the basic map to make navigation a little more interesting.

Give it a look! And if you like it, maybe you'll give it a wishlist too?

-Sudo

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3045260/Kamikaze_Tactics/
